subtitle: Application Integrity & Player Acceptance Readiness
changes: Added read-only Application Integrity diagnostics in Data & Backup to inspect duplicate interface IDs, navigation destinations, archived studio visibility and essential studio controls.
Added a first-party Player Acceptance Checklist for PC and iPhone testers with clear testing categories and locally prepared report text; no information is automatically submitted.
The integrity diagnostics neither fetch remote APIs nor read, modify or clear user records, music, builds, account tokens, or backup files.
Preserved the existing Sovereign Data Vault restore and preview safeguards, Blizzard API integrations, Talent Forge, HYPER MUSIC, and all existing release workflows.
Prepared regression checks for the new tools while leaving real character testing and mobile acceptance verification pending until players are available.
